text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is our meeting about the training plan.
However—
I mistakenly ended up talking about last week's agenda.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Like hell it is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Mistake...
Did I use it—at the wrong time?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Every now and then... they bring it up in conversation.
Japanese comedians—
...that topic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I do not understand.
But—...laughter is a nation's—unique culture.
Extremely—important...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Therefore—I am in the middle—...of researching.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Symboli Kris S's research into comedy.
Honestly, I was intrigued by what it might entail,
so I decided to observe her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: “The Multilayered Structure of Laughter,” “Kyogen: The Folklore of Laughter,” “50 Years of a Comedic Life”... These shall be... today's research materials.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—The hell? Are you an idiot?
That's enough already. Shut up—”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Kris S-san! Did you find that "Philosophy of Humor" book I lent you the other day helpful?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But—the theory of "objectification"—
in humor—was slightly—difficult to grasp.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That part is quite difficult, isn't it? That feeling of "dislocation"—and how "oneself" becomes "objectified" within the "overall situation"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In addition—in regards to straight-man retorts—
—the change in 'relative status'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure it was a meaningful discussion, but I wondered if any of it would actually translate into real comedy. Just as that crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see, so you are researching this country's humor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âRudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Humor is heavily influenced by cultural differences.
Even within the country, it varies from region to region.
Studying it should prove useful in understanding Japan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However, as seen in overseas races,
humor is also a distant frontier.
Trying to grasp it through short-term research—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can't... not so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
—...Without rushing—I'll continue my research.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, please do.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, that was a pun just now...
Playing on "research" and "no can do, so suddenly"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Advanced level. Was that... humor of the highest caliber?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Learning... insufficient.
Straight-man retort, failed... Still a long way to go.
choice_data_list: Hard work will pay off someday!
It's also important to feel the humor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will devote myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Then—first—DAJARE.
I will learn them—from Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward. Symboli Kris S began slipping indescribably
awkward puns into every corner of our conversations—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see—so it's "feeling."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes, to sense that is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It is essential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, feelings—crucial.
—Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Setting aside whether understanding the meaning
would make it funny—Symboli Kris S's
efforts continued unabated thereafter.
